title: Script editor doesn't focus with ctrl + f3 on script workspace
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]
v4.7.dev1.official [bf95b6258]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

`ctrl + f3` doesn't focus the script editor when the script workspace is active, but another dock is focused, ex: FileSystem (alt + f).
The current workaround is to switch to another workspace then back to the script workspace:
- 2d (ctrl + f1)
- script (ctrl + f3)


### Steps to reproduce

- switch to the script workspace (ctrl + f3)
- open an existing file or create a new file
- see the cursor blinking in the script editor
- focus another dock, ex: the filesystem (alt + f) or the scene dock, (shift + ctrl + p, type: scene dock, press: enter)
- try to focus the script editor (ctrl + f3, or shift + ctrl + p, type: script editor, press: enter)
- issue, the script editor doesn't become focused, the previous dock remains focused

Expected:
Focus the script editor with (ctrl + f3, and shift + ctrl + p, type: script editor, press: enter), on the script workspace, when another dock is focused.

Workaround:
- switch to the 2d workspace (ctrl + f1)
- switch to the script workspace (ctrl + f3)
